cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.description: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
